about: JK Tyre & Industries Limited develops, manufactures, markets and distributes automotive tyres, tubes, flaps, and retreads in India, Mexico, and Internationally. The company offers tyres for truck/bus radial and bias, light and small commercial vehicle bias, two/three-wheeler, farm radial and bias, off-the-road and industrial, racing, light and small commercial vehicle radical, passenger car radial and bias, specialty, and military/defence.
